precios.title: No surprises. No fine print.
precios.ofertaBanner: 25% OFF if you sign up today
precios.footnote: One-time setup, no lock-in, cancel whenever you want

items.p: How does it connect to my business's WhatsApp?
items.r: We link the agent to your existing WhatsApp Business number. You don't change numbers or install anything on the customer's side.

items.p: Do my customers know it's an AI?
items.r: The agent introduces itself by name and responds naturally. If it ever can't resolve something, it hands it off to the person in charge immediately.

items.p: What happens if the agent doesn't know how to answer something?
items.r: It apologizes, says it's passing it on to the person in charge, and it's logged in the dashboard as something that needs your attention.
Less than 48 hours from when you share your business info to when the agent is responding on your real WhatsApp.

items.p: Can I change the agent's information later?
items.r: Yes, any time from the dashboard: menu, prices, hours, house rules — all editable.

items.p: Does it work for any size of business?
items.r: Yes. From a single-owner shop to chains with several locations, every plan scales to however many agents you need.

items.p: Is there a contract or lock-in period?
items.r: No. It's a monthly subscription with no lock-in. You only pay the initial setup once.

items.p: What happens if I want to cancel?
items.r: Cancel whenever you want from the dashboard, no penalties, no questions asked.

mensajes.texto: Hi! Do you have a table for 4 on Friday at 9 PM?
Hi! Yes, I have availability 🌿 Who should I put it under?
Martin Suarez
Done Martin, table for 4 on Friday at 9 PM. Would you like the sidewalk seating or inside?
Inside is better
Perfect, it's confirmed. See you then!
Hi, I'd like to order 2 breaded milanesas to go
Sure! 2 breaded milanesas come to $29,800 total. Want to add a dessert or drink?
A glass of red wine
Added it 🍷 That's $34,600 total. Are you picking it up or should we send it for delivery?
I'll swing by to pick it up
Perfect, it'll be ready for pickup in 25 minutes.
The food arrived cold and on top of that the waiter ignored us all night
Ugh, I'm really sorry about that 🙏 I'm passing this on to the manager right now so they can reach out to you.
I hope you do something about it, it was a bad experience
Completely understandable. The manager will message you shortly to make it right — you won't be left like this.
Hi, are you listing any 2-bedroom apartments in Palermo?
Hi! Yes, we have 4 units available in the area. Are you looking to rent or buy?
To rent
Great. Rentals in Palermo run from $450,000 to $680,000 depending on size and amenities. Do you have a budget in mind?
Up to 550 thousand
I have 2 units that fit right in that range. Want me to schedule a visit this week?

mensajes.texto: Hi, how much is a dental cleaning?
Hi! A full dental cleaning is $28,000 and includes polishing and fluoride. Would you like to book?
Yes, do you have anything this week?
I have Thursday 10:30 AM or Friday 4:00 PM. Which works better for you?
Thursday works. I'm Lucia Fernandez
Done Lucia, Thursday 10:30 AM. Come 10 minutes early with your ID.
Hi! Do you do permanent hair removal?
Hi! Yes, we work with diode laser ✨ A full-leg session is $45,000.
How many sessions do I need?
Usually between 6 and 8. We have a 6-session package for $230,000, which saves you almost $40,000.
I'm interested! Can I come Saturday?
I have Saturday at 11 AM. Can you give me your name to book you in?
Good afternoon, what options do you have for a fixed-term deposit?
Good afternoon. We offer traditional fixed-term deposits and mutual funds. What term are you thinking of?
About a year
For that term there are options in local currency and in dollars with different risk profiles. Want me to schedule a call with an advisor to see what fits best?
Sure, tomorrow afternoon
Perfect. Can you give me your name and an approximate investment range so the advisor can prepare the options?
Hi! How much is a package to Cancun for 2 people?
Hi! We have departures in October starting at $1,850,000 per person, 7 nights all inclusive with flights ✈️
Does it include transfers?
Yes, in/out transfers and travel assistance are included. There are 6 spots left on the October 12th departure.
I'm interested, how do I proceed?
I'll set you up with an advisor to put together the final quote. Your name and a time that works for you?
